notes: All 48 matches come from ESPN's ger.dfb_pokal feed ('German Cup'): first round 32 (21-24 Aug, plus 1 and 2 Sep 2026 for Dortmund and Bayern after the Supercup, per dfb.de), second round 16 (27-28 Oct 2026). First-round results confirmed by the DFB Datencenter (Tier 1, datencenter.dfb.de) and, for 30 of 32, by Sky Sports. Every first-round winner is in the second round.

Format (dfb.de 'Modus' and 'Wettbewerbsinformationen'): 64 clubs, single matches, extra time (2 x 15 min) then penalties. Round of 16 on 1-2 Dec 2026 (draw Sun 1 Nov 2026, 19:15 German time, ARD Sportschau); quarter-finals 2/3 and 9/10 Feb 2027; semi-finals 20/21 Apr 2027; final Sat 29 May 2027, 20:00 German time (18:00 UTC) in Berlin (Wikipedia, Tier 3, names the Olympiastadion; DFB says only 'Berlin', so no venue is stored).

Shoot-outs: the DFB Datencenter shows the shoot-out score itself ('4 : 5 i.E.'); stored as PEN with the score after 120 minutes, regular time and extra time split by the goal minutes, and the shoot-out in pens. AET results are split the same way.
Second-round kick-offs: ESPN times; the DFB Datencenter round page gives the same times in German time (CET).
